How it works

Four steps. You can stop at any of them, and money only changes hands once you say yes.

1

Talk

Ten minutes on WhatsApp. You tell me what the business is and what it should show. No forms.

2

In two or three days I build a demo of your site and send it to you. This costs nothing.

3

Your yes

If you like it, half the payment. If you do not, we cancel and you pay nothing.

The site goes on the internet and the link is yours. The other half is paid then.

Questions

Nothing hidden here. Anything else, just ask on WhatsApp.

Why is this so cheap? Is something wrong with it?

I am an engineering student starting out on my own. I have no office to pay for, so my rates are low. The work is complete — look at the demo and judge it yourself.

Do you have any clients?

Not a paying one yet — you could be the first, and that is exactly why the rates are this low. Every template on this site was designed and built by me, and you can open any of them and click through it. Two entries are my own projects rather than templates, and the enquiry form is the one running on this site.

When do I pay?

After you have seen the demo. Half when you approve it, the other half when the site goes live. If you do not like it, you pay nothing and there is no argument.

What will it cost me every month?

Nothing for hosting. The only yearly cost is a domain, and only if you want your own name like yourshop.in — that is ₹700-1,000 a year, paid to the domain company, not to me.

What if I need to change a number or a price later?

Small changes — a number, a photo, a price — I handle. Premium includes the first month free. After that it is ₹999 a year for as many changes as you need.

I do not have good photos.

That is fine. Send whatever you have from your phone and I will clean it up. Where there is no photo at all, the design carries it — the whole hero of the Mithai Wala site is a painted board, with no photo anywhere.

Will my site show up on Google?

Business and Premium include the basic setup — title, description and sitemap. Premium also prepares your Google Business profile, though you have to finish the verification yourself, because Google sends a postcard or asks for a video call.

Is the free demo really free?

Yes. I build three free demos a month, because each one takes about two days. After that, the next one moves to the following month.

Shall we start today?

Send me the name of your business and your city on WhatsApp. I will ask the rest.
